name: LastMileManifestManager
tagline: Driver manifests, stop sequence, delivery outcomes and cash-on-delivery cash-ups – the depot control desk in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete last-mile delivery app for parcel carriers, 3PLs, retail fleets and wholesalers in one Power Apps code component: manifests with the stop sequence (reorder, optimise by time window, renumber), dispatch with driver, vehicle and capacity checks, every outcome with business rules – proof of delivery, cash on delivery within tolerance, failed attempts with reasons and an attempt limit, redelivery within a horizon, returns – time-window and dwell checks, a status board and per-driver COD reconciliation with supervisor approval of variances.
features: Stop sequence with drag / ▲▼ reorder and Save sequence
Dispatch with crew, address, capacity and max-stops rules
Deliver with proof of delivery (signature, ID check, photo, PIN, safe place)
Cash on delivery with tolerance and payment method
Failed attempts with reasons and attempt limit
Reschedule within a horizon – straight onto tomorrow's manifest
Window missed / late / at-risk and dwell checks
Driver COD cash-up with variance approval
Run sheets, bulk dispatch / reschedule / move, undo, CSV export
Demo mode with a fictional parcel network
Phone layout with bottom view bar
